svg.title: Harvest run on an Instagram reel
svg.desc: One real harvest (2026-10-14) of a 46-second reel whose caption only says "comment CODING for the links": caption, local speech-to-text and one contact sheet; one tool adopted because it answers the project's stated pain, three rejected with reasons, nothing installed, temp media deleted.
svg.text: ## Harvest — "Your Claude Code is running at 0/4 power" (Instagram reel)
Read: caption · local speech-to-text · contact sheet of 6 shots
53 s · 4.1 MB fetched · 17.4 MB deleted · nothing written to the project
Pain found in README: "UI bugs are hard to debug, we only test by hand in the browser"

text.tspan: answers the stated pain · repo audited:

svg.text: telemetry on by default → proposed pinned,

text.tspan: need absent: offline app, no database
need absent: nothing deployed, no git remote
need absent · owner read off the contact sheet

Comments not read, on purpose. Engagement bait flagged: the links were never in the caption.
